text:
Asha: Okay team tiny-media swap: recommend one song (<=4min) and one visual thing (short film, single TV ep, or standalone doc under 45min). No feature films.
Asha: I'll kick off: Song — 'Elliott Smith - Angeles' (simmering, 3:20). Visual — 'World of Tomorrow' (Don Hertzfeldt short, ~17 min).
Tom: Love that short. My picks:
Tom: Song — 'TV on the Radio - Wolf Like Me' (3:37). Visual — 'Black Mirror: Hang the DJ' (single ep, ~45 min) — borderline but tight.
Bea: Going weirdly upbeat:
Bea: Song — 'Chairlift - Bruises' (3:13). Visual — 'Pipilotti Rist: Ever Is Over All' (video art piece, ~4 min) — silly but lovely.
Eli: For commute headphone users:
Eli: Song — 'The Cinematic Orchestra - To Build a Home' (3:45). Visual — 'Paterson' is a feature so not allowed but the short film 'Maggie's' is great (20 min) — also, check Criterion Channel for rotating minis.
calendar-bot: Reminder: "Casual Friday Listening Hour" scheduled Fri 11:15 AM. Add an item to the agenda if you'd like to present your pick. (organizer: Asha)
Ollie: Quick poll: emoji react with :one: if your pick is Nostalgia, :two: for Mood, :three: for Experimental. I'll tally.
Bea: Also, if anyone wants to bring a physical zine or small DVD for the swap shelf, drop it at the front desk before Friday.
Tom: Playlist idea: I'll make a short 12-track playlist with one pick from each person. Want me to share as collaborative?
Asha: Yes please. Sharing link when ready :) Also curious if anyone has a portable projector we could borrow for the listening/viewing hour.
Eli: I have one in storage — happy to bring it. :projector:
Bea: Results so far: :one: 2 :two: 3 :three: 1 — Mood leading.
Ollie: Tiny curation tip: if you want a compact visual, look for 'shorts' on Mubi and Vimeo Staff Picks, they have great under-20min pieces.
Tom: Playlist incoming. Link: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1exampleDifferentLink (placeholder)
Asha: Excellent. See you all Friday. If anyone wants to demo their pick for 3-4 minutes during the hour, sign up here: https://tiny.signup/2min-demos
